text:
Nina V: quick one for month-end — during the partner program cutover on Apr 1 we shipped a batch of prepaid partner rebates that were applied as contra-revenue instead of being recorded to the 24-month deferred liability. noticed in the deferral roll-forward.
Harold J: ouch. do you have sample invoices or memo ids?
Nina V: yep pasted a short export from billing: ``
invoice_id,partner,customer,invoice_date,amount,treatment_expected,treatment_actual
INV-2026-1012,EdgeRack,alpha-corp,2026-04-03,24000,defer-24m,contra-revenue
INV-2026-1020,EdgeRack,beta-inc,2026-04-10,8000,defer-24m,contra-revenue
INV-2026-1031,EdgeRack,gamma-llc,2026-04-22,6000,defer-24m,contra-revenue
``
Nina V: total $38k posted as immediate contra-revenue in Apr. policy is to defer and amortize.
Priya K: materiality triggers our correction threshold. we need a correcting JE and schedule fix. is cash/AR affected?
Nina V: cash posted for all and AR zeroed; so this is classification only.
Harold J: recommended steps: 1) reverse contra-revenue entries and post to 2300-PARTNER-DEFERRED ($38,000) as of May close (JE template below); 2) create DEF-PARTNER-24M lines in the revenue schedule starting May 1 with correct amortization; 3) include schedule note and ticket for audit.
Harold J: JE template: DR 4000-CONTRA-REV $38,000 / CR 2300-PARTNER-DEFERRED $38,000. memo: "Reclass partner rebates incorrectly recorded as contra-revenue due to cutover mapping (RR-2026-0821)"
Priya K: i approve JE and remediation. please attach partner contract excerpt confirming amortization term to the ticket.
Nina V: created ticket RR-2026-0821 and attached billing export + partner contract snippet; assigning to @Nina V; due: 2026-05-03. revrec-bot?
revrec-bot: ticket RR-2026-0821 created; checklist: billing export, GL support, contract excerpt, cutover PR link. assigned to Nina V.
Emma Q: two audit points: a) include a one-line disclosure in the May close pack noting "Reclassification of partner rebates originally posted as contra-revenue due to partner program cutover; amounts deferred and amortized over contractual term (RR-2026-0821)"; b) retain original contra-revenue supporting docs for external reviewers.
Priya K: noted. Nina, can you confirm the cutover PR that caused mapping change?
Nina V: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/billing-configs/pull/455 - it changed partner rebate mapping and omitted the deferred_rule field for EdgeRack. i've opened a follow-up PR to backfill defaults.
Harold J: one more check — tax treatment? if contra-revenue was used, tax basis might differ. Priya / tax team to confirm.
Priya K: will loop tax. tagging them in the ticket.
Nina V: final: posting JE in May close window, updating schedules, and adding the May footnote. will update thread when JE done. thanks. :white_check_mark:
